facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.title: audit finding - assurance activity of material unwanted event control at PSV-8210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-8210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-8210 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 24 November 2025 a planned assurance activity of PSV-8210 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station found the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems not effective.
